name: 24969-4kimage-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.3B: a 32-block vision tower (patch 14, 2x2 spatial merge) in front of a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query heads, 4 KV heads, 128k window). Full config on the checkpoint.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=8 req/s, bounded at 1200 requests with a 900 s safety cap; warmup the first 20% and cooldown the last 10% by completion. The client is not the bound here: measured through guidellm's own loader on this fixture, 192.7 rows/s against the 8 req/s asked for.
workload: Single-image chat: one 3840x2160 photograph -- THE SAME PICTURE EVERY REQUEST -- and one short question that varies per row, 32 output tokens with `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0`. Driven from `configs/data/repeat-4k.jsonl`, 1600 rows regenerated by `configs/data/make-fixture.py` (seed 24969, deterministic); ~226 kB of base64 JPEG per request on the wire. Under the declared `max_pixels: 401408` the frame is 1920 vision patches, 480 image tokens, 519 prompt tokens with the chat template. Two guidellm properties fix the fixture's shape: it walks a file dataset once and does not cycle, so the fixture must be longer than `max_requests`; and its media encoder passes an `image` column that is already `{"type": ..., "image": "data:image/jpeg;base64,..."}` straight through, so each row carries the picture itself and nothing has to resolve a path relative to the harness's working directory.
purpose: A visual question-answering assistant on one GPU, fielding eight requests per second about a single 4K photo.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Nothing here is tuned: there is no tuned.yaml and no tunable.yaml.
# Everything not listed is left at the engine's defaults, and no VLLM_* variable is set.

model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct

# The vision budget. 401408 = 512 x 28 x 28, i.e. "at most 512 image tokens": it puts the declared
# 3840x2160 frame at 480 image tokens instead of 10549.
# INLINE JSON, not an indented block: the config reader is line-based and skips every line starting
# with a space, so a block-form dict silently never reaches the engine.
mm-processor-kwargs: {"max_pixels": 401408}

tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Worst case on the wire is 519 prompt + 32 output = 551 tokens; the checkpoint's own 128k window
# would reserve KV this item never touches.
max-model-len: 2048
